label: feedback_evaluation-example
grammar:
root ::= ws value
value-verdict ::= ("\"show\"" | "\"hide\"") ws
value-reason ::= nonempty
value ::= "{" ws "\"verdict\"" ws ":" ws value-verdict "," ws "\"reason\"" ws ":" ws value-reason "}" ws
string ::= "\"" char* "\"" ws
nonempty ::= "\"" char+ "\"" ws
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F\x7F] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" hex hex hex hex)
hex ::= [0-9a-fA-F]
ws ::= [ \t\r\n]*

messages.content: Evaluate whether the proposed live suggestion would help right now. Return JSON with verdict (show or hide) and reason. Ground the decision in the recent transcript; reply in English.

Firnloop Labs planning call. Speaker 1: I am Mina Vale. The harbor sensor trial needs one more battery test. Speaker 2: I am Oren Talo. I will test the battery on Thursday. Speaker 1: We will decide whether to begin the trial after the test; we have not approved a start date.
Candidate suggestion: Ask Oren which day he will test the battery.
